title: A Capsule Slammed Into the Atmosphere at 27,000 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: A capsule slammed into the atmosphere at 27,000 miles an hour.
On September 24, 2023, NASA's OSIRIS-REx capsule fell back to Earth.
It carried rocks from an asteroid named Bennu.
Friction heated its shield to nearly 5,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
A parachute opened at about 20,000 feet.
It landed in the Utah desert at 8:52 in the morning.
A piece of an asteroid, delivered like a package from space.

description:
NASA's OSIRIS-REx capsule hit the atmosphere at over 27,000 miles an hour.
It landed in the Utah desert on September 24, 2023, carrying rocks from the asteroid Bennu.
What would you do with a piece of an asteroid?
first_comment: Rocks from an asteroid, delivered. What should we ask NASA to bring back next?
